label: BL
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) flagged due to separate DNS resolution and fetch. While user input flows to the fetch sink, the validation checks the resolved IP address (via resolveHost) whereas the actual connection uses the hostname string (via fetchHttpByHostname). This creates a DNS rebinding window where the IP checked differs from the IP fetched. As per BL calibration rules, without visibility into DNS TTL, resolver cache, or egress policy, this split renders the exploitability unclear rather than definitively exploitable.

evidence.note: DNS check on resolved IP followed by fetch using hostname string enables DNS rebinding possibility
